pages.text: Swap any $(item)Ring Frame$() for a Reactor Port. Ports are the reactor's power connection.

$(li)$(thing)Before ignition$(): feed RF in to charge the core.$(li)$(thing)While running$(): they push power into any cable or machine touching them.$(li)$(thing)Comparator$(): reads the core's stability, 0 to 15.
